combinations.readout: analgesic effect (thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia), oxidative stress and inflammation markers
combinations.magnitude: analgesic, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects attenuated
combinations.evidence_quote: Notably, co-administration with zinc protoporphyrin (ZnPP), a pharmacological inhibitor of heme oxygenase activity, attenuated the analgesic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects of 4-PSB-2, suggesting that activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway contributes to the protective effects of 4-PSB-2.
